item.title: Kyuzen 0.1.1
item.description:
This release exists to prove that updating works: if you are reading this inside Kyuzen, it did.

The About page now shows Kyuzen's own version, and Settings carries a choice for how updates arrive: ask first, install quietly, or never check.

item.title: Kyuzen 0.1.0
item.description:
The first release of Kyuzen: a Chromium browser with a vertical sidebar, spaces bound to separate logins, a command box, peek and split-free navigation.

This release exists to prove that updating works. It is signed ad-hoc rather than with a Developer ID, so macOS will warn when you open it by hand.
